name: Arat Fraca
description: Arat Fraca was a planet located in the Arat Fraca system of the Colonies. The Star Morning suddenly reappeared over Arat Fraca a year after leaving Motexx for Gowdawl. Arat Fraca was two sectors away from Motexx. From Arat Fraca, the Star Morning proceeded to Darepp, where it landed.
lead_paragraphs: Arat Fraca was a planet located in the Arat Fraca system of the Colonies. The Star Morning suddenly reappeared over Arat Fraca a year after leaving Motexx for Gowdawl. Arat Fraca was two sectors away from Motexx. From Arat Fraca, the Star Morning proceeded to Darepp, where it landed.
